authorization_contract.rule: Unique one-time authorization identity; reuse is rejected.
All identities are recorded; reviewer and approver must be distinct.
Authorization is time bounded and rejected after expiry.
Bind exact blocked-plan path, SHA256, schema, ready status, and candidate count.
Bind preflight SHA256 and the complete ordered candidate-binding-set SHA256.
Bind a separately reviewed evaluator version plus all staged payload byte hashes; absent today.
Explicitly allow only historical component-QC create-only targets; deny overwrite, fit, release, import, COM, route, identity, and coefficient actions.
Compensating rollback may remove only files created by this authorization whose readback hash matches the transaction ledger.

atomic_write_contract.rule: Recompute blocked plan from exact preflight and rehash all source artifacts; any drift holds the batch.
A future reviewed evaluator derives every payload outside historical point directories; current design has no evaluator.
Validate canonical schema, analyzer coverage, grade semantics, source lineage, and byte hashes for all candidates before creating any target.
Every exact target must still be absent immediately before commit; replacement and overwrite APIs are forbidden.
Create exact targets with OS-level exclusive create semantics. Cross-directory batch atomicity is not assumed.
Flush each new file and directory, read exact bytes back, compare SHA256, and parse canonical schema before proceeding.
Only a complete 125/125 readback ledger may close the write transaction; fitting remains separately blocked.

next_action: Keep historical writes locked. Build a separate authorization validator and reviewed payload evaluator before implementing any create-only writer.
